elevate.move: Finish the evidence file: every frame gets the same flashlight-lit field grade, edges darkened and one circle of light on the actual subject (grade line, galleries, rafter joint), with crops ordered as the walk from outside to paperwork, so the light that found each defect unifies the shoot.

Make each station band a report page sized to its content, photo and text ending on one baseline, with the hero's header rule repeated ('Station 0X · Page X of 6'), so the scroll reads as pages turning before the dense price band and the quiet report.
